description: This file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Child, which is a compiler plugin for the Smarty templating engine. It handles the compilation of the {child} tag in Smarty templates, managing attributes, block nesting, and output generation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Child
classes.description: A compiler class for handling the {child} tag in Smarty templates. It extends Smarty_Internal_CompileBase and generates PHP code to process the block, handle attribute assignment, and manage inheritance calls.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the {child} template tag, managing attribute extraction, block nesting checks, code output for inheritance calls, and optional variable assignment.
